active_family: state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law with one stochastic source and one shared generative core; first backend remains AR flow matching unless diagnostics justify a switch
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, generic support-aware mixed discrete-continuous heads selected by one data-derived rule, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, factor-name-specific sparse heads, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
deployable_tri_scope_incumbent: 734a/739a real-VIX framework-lock baseline: risk-manager-presentable for IV plus liquid anchors and native joint co-movement, with sticky OAS monitored as a limitation.
iv_research_frontier: 755a short-prefix generated-FM IV-only branch: validation 6/11 and train-tail 8/11, preserves mean reversion, not promoted until tri-scope framework-lock non-regression is run.
promotion_policy: A new model can replace the deployable incumbent only if the same framework recipe is evaluated on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint and passes tri-scope non-regression against 734a/739a. IV-only improvements can update iv_research_frontier only; they cannot be called the current deployable model. Old conditionality is replaced by risk-state uncertainty allocation when that diagnostic passes. Old IV-EWMA cointegration is monitoring-only until a formal new cointegration/dependence gate is defined.

normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, output_law, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: Workflow corrected: do not chase IV-only strict-suite or proper-law repairs without tri-scope non-regression. 734a/739a remains the deployable tri-scope incumbent; 755a remains the IV-only research frontier. 765a shows level-support repair via proper scaled-delta level CRPS is useful only when budget matched, but it is rejected because it regresses full-horizon mean reversion.
last_result_summary: 765a trained the 755a short-prefix recipe from 674a with channel_level_energy_weight=0 and level_marginal_crps_weight=0.007 in scaled_delta space. Validation stayed 6/11; train-tail reached 7/11. It improves materially over additive 762a but remains below 755a train-tail 8/11 and worsens mean-reversion active profile.

Old IV-EWMA cointegration is monitoring-only unless a formal new gate is defined.
